import pandas as pd

# Source file path
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_55/training_0.csv"

# Load source data with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0_df = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)

# Transformation:
# Target schema: ['V_GENE']
# Source schema: ['J_CALL']
# The target column V_GENE corresponds to the part of J_CALL before the '*' character.
# Extract the substring before '*' from J_CALL to create V_GENE.

source0_df['V_GENE'] = source0_df['J_CALL'].str.split('*').str[0]

# Select only the target column
target_df = source0_df[['V_GENE']]

# Write the transformed data to the target CSV file
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_55/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
